This page is a plain static test page. It has no JavaScript at all. The audit kit must read it as a normal server-rendered page and must never call it an empty shell. Every word you read here is in the HTML that the server sends, so a crawler that does not run scripts still sees the full page.

What we do

We fix leaking pipes, clear blocked drains and install new water heaters for homes and small shops. Our team works six days a week and gives a written price before any work starts.
